Text.Text: Unmoving Center isn't a lesson anymore. It's just how you stand now. Keep it that way when the wind picks up.
You're braced for a blow that hasn't come. Reach rank 50 in Staff, then return. We can work on what to do with the waiting.

Six Unmoving Center adepts are holding the Anchorhead Canyon Range. They learned to be still, then mistook that for never letting anyone pass. Defeat the six and bring me their tally. I want to see what they've made of the lesson.
Take the key to the canyon range entrance at Anchorhead's north entrance. You needn't arrive fighting. Let yourself see the ground first.

The staff doesn't move. Everything moves around it. That's the whole trick: find the point that doesn't have to go anywhere, and let the fight orbit it. Most people spend years hunting motion. I'm done hunting.
The canyon range entrance is at Anchorhead's north entrance, on Tatooine. My key gets you through. If you're bringing friends, have them stand close when you open it.
Adepts, mostly. They still lean on their weight when they swing. You'll feel the wrongness in it before you see it.
Six adepts in the Anchorhead Canyon Range. Bring their tally here to the cantina. Breathe before you step into reach.
Six down, and the tally to prove it. Let's see it.
Recorded. The first stillness holds. Rest today; tomorrow the range gets harder to fool.

Five specialists have the canyon's sightline calibrator. They've arranged the lanes so the world has to move around them. Beat the five and bring it here. Stillness shouldn't depend on making everyone else stand where you choose.
Five specialists, one calibrator. You know the range. Take your time reading the lanes.
Rigidity isn't stillness. Rigid things shatter first. These specialists hold a pose and call it mastery. I've watched three of them crack under a first real hit. That's what you're going to test.
The canyon range entrance is at Anchorhead's north entrance, on Tatooine. My key gets you through. If you're bringing friends, have them stand close when you open it.
Better footwork than the adepts, worse instincts. They've drilled the shapes long enough to look convincing at a glance.
Five specialists on the canyon range have the calibrator. Bring it here when they're beaten.
Five down, and their calibrator in your hand. Show me.
Recorded. You're not fidgeting either, not yet. Keep that.

The warden holds the canyon range. Challenge her there and bring back her shattered crest when she's beaten. Ask others to come if you wish. You'll want someone steady beside you when she makes you move.
Bring two who can be still when you cannot. The warden won't care that you came alone.

It demands you stop flinching before the hit lands, not after. The warden never flinches. That's not a boast. I've watched her take a hit that should have ended her and just kept standing. That's the discipline working, or it's something else wearing the discipline's face.
Use the challenge marker on the Anchorhead Canyon Range. That calls her. Take a breath first. She has no reason to hurry.

Bring company. Stillness holds when someone else is drawing the storm toward them instead of you. That's the only reason I send you with two others instead of alone. The warden won't wait for you to be ready.
Call the warden at the canyon range challenge marker. Defeat her and recover the shattered crest.
The warden's down and you're still standing. Let's see the crest.
Recorded. That's the first proof I didn't expect to see. Don't let it go to your head; the ones after her are worse.

Four instructors still have the marshal's challenge chit. They stand together and call it proof that the school is sound. Defeat the four on the range and bring the chit here. We can judge the lesson without their circle around it.
Bring the chit here. You don't have to turn every time their circle does.

It demands you let go of the circle they've built around each other. Four of them stand back to back and call that unity. It's just four people afraid to be still alone. I never needed the other three.
The four instructors are on the canyon range. They still have the marshal's chit. Keep your own footing when their circle starts moving.
Four means four angles at once. Bring your own circle, or you'll spend the whole fight turning.
Four instructors on the range still have the marshal's chit. Return it after you've broken their circle.
All four, and their chit besides. You've earned a look at it.
Recorded. There's one lesson left, and it isn't mine to give lightly. Rest first.

My old master is in the Canyon Dueling Pit. Call her at the challenge marker and defeat her. She will wait for you to hurry. Give yourself time to see what she's waiting for, then return here to the cantina.
Call her in the Canyon Dueling Pit. Take company if you can. I'll be here at the cantina when you're ready to speak of what happened.

It demands you understand what I'm asking you to end. She found the center and never left it. That's not victory, whatever it looks like from outside. I want you to stop her before stillness finishes swallowing her the rest of the way, or before she does the same to you.
The Canyon Dueling Pit. Call her at the challenge marker there. Give yourself time to see the floor before she makes you use it.

Everything you're learning to do, she already does without trying. That's what I'm sending you to stand against, and why I'm telling you plainly: don't stand against it alone. Bring two you'd trust with your back. She's earned every one of the people who didn't.
The Canyon Dueling Pit holds the master's challenge marker. Defeat her, then return to the Anchorhead Cantina.
She's not standing anymore. That's all the proof I need. Tell me it's done.

You're back. Sit a moment. Your pay can wait until your hands settle. If you want to learn Unmoving Center, I will teach you. You have seen enough now to know that standing still is a choice you keep making.
Anyway, the job.
Six adepts. I can do that.
What's this stillness supposed to be, exactly?
Where do I find them?
What am I walking into?
Not yet.
Here's your tally.
Anyway, the job.
Five specialists, then.
What makes them different from the adepts?
Same range?
What should I watch for this time?
I need a moment.
Here's the calibrator.
Back to it.
I'll bring people. Where's the warden?
What's different about the warden?
Where do I find her?
How many should I bring?
Give me time to find good company.
Her crest. We got her.
Back to it.
I'll gather my circle.
Who are they to you?
Where's their floor?
How many should I bring this time?
Let me find four I trust first.
Their chit. All four are down.
Back to it.
I'll challenge her. Tell me where.
What am I actually ending?
Where does she wait?
What is she going to do?
I need to prepare for this.
It's done. She's not standing.
